text: {"lessons":["A few months of price history did not tell me what prices would do next, so I should base trades on a plan rather than recent moves.","I sold several positions at gains after the account had fallen; I should assess each holding on its prospects, not let loss aversion or the comfort of locking in gains drive decisions.","My average cost is not a reason to keep a poor investment or sell a sound one; I should be willing to reconsider each position without treating a sale at a loss as an admission of failure."]}
